phrasings.text: Actually we use request() from src/lib/api.js to call services, not fetch.
Service calls go through request("mail", "/send", ...) in lib/api.js; it handles retries and the base URL.
Please remember: never call fetch directly, use the api helper.
use request from lib/api.js instead of fetch
We don't talk to services with raw fetch here. request(service, path) does it.
